_readme: The Check Engine crash library. Each entry is a crash someone already solved. 'all': every text must be in the crash report or log; 'any': at least one must be; 'none': none may be. First match wins, so put narrow entries above broad ones. Raise 'version' with every change so players with updates on get it. To add one, open a pull request or an issue with the crash report and the fix that worked.

crashes.title: RivaTuner / MSI Afterburner overlay
crashes.detail: The game died inside RivaTuner Statistics Server, the on-screen FPS overlay that comes with MSI Afterburner. It hooks into the game's graphics and modded Minecraft often trips over it.
crashes.fix: Close RivaTuner Statistics Server (or turn its overlay off for javaw.exe), then start the game again.

crashes.title: Discord overlay
crashes.detail: The game died inside Discord's in-game overlay.
crashes.fix: Turn off Discord's in-game overlay (Discord settings > Game Overlay), then start the game again.

crashes.title: No proper graphics driver
crashes.detail: Windows has no OpenGL driver for the graphics card the game is using, usually because only Windows' basic display driver is installed.
crashes.fix: Install the driver from your graphics card maker (NVIDIA, AMD or Intel), restart the PC, then start the game. On a laptop, make javaw.exe use the dedicated graphics card.
any: WGL: The driver does not appear to support OpenGL

crashes.title: Java couldn't get the memory you gave it
crashes.detail: The launcher asked Java for more memory than it could reserve. This happens with 32-bit Java, or when the RAM setting is higher than the PC can spare.
crashes.fix: Lower the RAM setting in your launcher (6 to 8 GB is plenty for most packs) and make sure the launcher uses 64-bit Java.
